cloud can be an effective alternative to HPC for some applications but not all, and that cloud virtualization mechanisms need to be optimized for HPC.

the cloud can be used effectively to complement HPC systems for applications that can tolerate high latencies and have low communication to computation ratio, but the cloud is not a replacement for supercomputers.
